acceptance: The module is the only causal truth and review persistence boundary and adds no USI, Memory, graph, provider, runtime, route, scheduler, migration, or activation integration.
An exact sqlite3.Connection is adopted by the store; the caller must stop using its alias until close, and no filesystem path enters the public boundary.

A new store initializes only an empty SQLite database with the exact application identity, version, tables, indexes, foreign keys, and no-update/no-delete triggers; reopening validates the exact schema and never migrates.
Claim identity is owner-, policy-, source-version-, claim-version-, candidate-actor-, and evidence-bound; initial state is candidate and records contain identifiers only.
Every review transition is one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, compares the expected head digest and from-state, appends one hash-chained immutable event, and exposes no partial success.
Only the eight accepted NMG-05 transitions are possible; retracted and superseded are terminal, and supported can never be reached from candidate or from an automatic source.
Every reviewer differs from both candidate_actor and owner; NMG-05A enforces separation but does not authenticate principals or mint review authority.
Conflict, alternative-cause, retraction, and supersession payloads satisfy their exact conditional bindings; supersession resolves an existing same-owner claim with a strictly greater claim_version.
Reads are exact-owner, exact-claim, exact-version and bounded; every read and append replays and verifies that claim's complete bounded hash chain before returning.
All public failures are fresh code-only errors from None; SQLite, callback, path, SQL, input, repr, and private content never escapes.
Focused, dependency, static, independent hostile QA, and final Root/Sol deep review pass on one frozen two-path candidate before release.

database_representation.adoption: type(connection) is sqlite3.Connection, not in a transaction; constructor clears trace, progress, and authorizer callbacks, enables foreign keys, and retains no caller object except the adopted connection
database_representation.close: idempotent close; every later public operation fails closed with closed
database_representation.connection_alias_rule: caller use after adoption is outside authority and forbidden; retained-alias tampering must be detected by exact schema, append-only triggers, and hash-chain verification
database_representation.initialization: initialize=True requires application_id 0, user_version 0, and zero sqlite_master objects before one atomic exact-schema creation
database_representation.open: initialize=False requires exact application_id, user_version, tables, columns, indexes, triggers, foreign keys, and no extra schema objects
schema_objects: no-update and no-delete triggers for both tables
database_representation.transactions: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; exact reload; bounded chain verification; compare expected head and state; append; re-read; COMMIT; rollback on BaseException

error_boundary.public_error: CausalClaimStoreError(code) normalizes non-exact or non-allowlisted codes to integrity_failed
error_boundary.rule: private exact internal failures preserve allowlisted codes; every other Exception or BaseException becomes a fresh storage_failed or integrity_failed from None with no cause, context, args, SQL, path, callback, or input text

forbidden: third writer path, database migration module, core database edit, route, facade export, registry, adapter, USI projection, Memory or graph integration
raw source content, claim prose, explanation text, filesystem path, URL, provider response, model output, secret, token, credential, or private identifier persistence

candidate generation, automatic promotion, reviewer minting, authentication, authorization, principal lookup, runtime query, Lens, plugin, scheduler, thread, task, process, network, provider, model, download, reindex, migration, import, backfill, delete, deploy, or live action
UPDATE or DELETE of claim or event rows, unbounded list/export, cross-owner enumeration, silent repair, schema upgrade, partial report, or caller-supplied SQL
hostile_matrix: exact dict/list/str/int/bool and sqlite3.Connection identity; reject subclasses, hostile __class__, Mapping/Sequence, one-shot iterators, getters, colliding keys, and protocol callbacks before behavior
mutate input dicts/lists and retained output after each call; persisted canonical bytes, projections, and later reads remain detached and unchanged
Exception and BaseException from comparison, hashing, JSON, SQLite callbacks, row access, transactions, rollback, and close never escape raw
wrong or extra application identity, schema object, table, column, index, trigger, foreign key, user_version, open transaction, row type, stored scalar type, JSON shape, or digest fails closed
duplicate claim/event exact replay is idempotent only when every canonical field matches; collision or stale head is conflict
all eight transition edges, every forbidden edge, direct candidate-to-supported, self review, owner review, candidate-actor review, empty evidence, and terminal replay
conflict and alternative-cause related refs, retraction prior version/reason, supersession same-owner target and strictly monotonic claim version
two connections race on one head; one append wins and the stale writer fails with no partial row; rollback and reopen preserve one valid chain
max, max+1, zero, negative, bool-as-int, 2^63-1, and overflow for identifiers, evidence counts, versions, event counts, and history limits

direct retained-connection UPDATE/DELETE is trigger-rejected; row insertion/replacement, digest corruption, sequence gaps, prior-digest substitution, cross-owner related refs, and extra schema objects are detected
static import and public operations add no USI, Memory, graph, plugin, provider, model, network, subprocess, thread, task, runtime, route, registry, or live effect

invariants.append_only: claim identity rows and review events are immutable; current epistemic state is derived only by verified ordered replay
invariants.authority: CausalClaimStore is sole causal truth/review persistence owner; USI may later consume only a rebuildable read projection
invariants.content: all persisted and returned values are bounded public identifiers, positive integers, fixed enums, booleans, or sha256 refs; no free text
invariants.evidence: claim creation and every transition require 1..16 exact sorted unique sha256 evidence refs
invariants.identity: claim_ref is derived from exact owner, claim_id, and positive claim_version; source_version and every evidence/head/event ref use lowercase sha256
invariants.owner_scope: all primary, foreign-key, read, transition, relation, replay, and uniqueness operations include owner; no owner fallback or global lookup
invariants.review: reviewer is an externally authenticated identifier supplied by a future caller; this slice only enforces exact identity and separation and never mints authority
invariants.terminal: retracted and superseded have no outgoing transition
invariants.truth_separation: no graph, Memory, USI, adapter, candidate generator, or model can write or promote causal truth
